notes: s001: the written interrogative particle takes the clause-opening 'If'; the competing reading marks it unrepresented and 'If' added under rule 55, and is named in the unit note.
s003 דָבָר takes 'to commune' with the infinitival marker, rather than the marker joining 'assay'.

s008: 'himself' is read as realizing the verb's own reflexive sense (rule 44's limit) rather than as a supplied object; the competing reading marks it added, since עָצַר here is Qal and rule 44's cited reflexives are Niphal and Hiphil.
s012 יָכֹל takes the separately written modal 'can'; nothing is fused, since the ASV writes no 'cannot' (rule 35).
